verses.ar: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ﴿۱﴾
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.

verses.ar: وَالطُّوۡرِ ۙ﴿۲﴾
verses.en: By the Mount;
And by the Book inscribed
On parchment unfolded;

verses.ar: وَّالۡبَیۡتِ الۡمَعۡمُوۡرِ ۙ﴿۵﴾
verses.en: And by the frequented House;

verses.ar: وَالسَّقۡفِ الۡمَرۡفُوۡعِ ۙ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: And by the elevated Roof;

verses.ar: وَالۡبَحۡرِ الۡمَسۡجُوۡرِ ۙ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: And by the swollen sea;

verses.ar: اِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّکَ لَوَاقِعٌ ۙ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: The punishment of thy Lord shall certainly come to pass;

verses.ar: مَّا لَہٗ مِنۡ دَافِعٍ ۙ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: There is none that can avert it.

verses.ar: یَّوۡمَ تَمُوۡرُ السَّمَآءُ مَوۡرًا ۙ﴿۱۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]On the day when the heaven will heave with awful heaving,

verses.ar: وَّتَسِیۡرُ الۡجِبَالُ سَیۡرًا ﴿ؕ۱۱﴾
verses.en: [✲]And the mountains will move, with terrible moving,

verses.ar: فَوَیۡلٌ یَّوۡمَئِذٍ لِّلۡمُکَذِّبِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۱۲﴾
verses.en: Then woe that day to those who reject the truth,
w: to those who reject the truth

verses.ar: الَّذِیۡنَ ہُمۡ فِیۡ خَوۡضٍ یَّلۡعَبُوۡنَ ﴿ۘ۱۳﴾
verses.en: Who sportingly indulge in idle talk.

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ یُدَعُّوۡنَ اِلٰی نَارِ جَہَنَّمَ دَعًّا ﴿ؕ۱۴﴾
verses.en: The day when they shall be thrust into the fire of Hell with a violent thrust.

verses.ar: ہٰذِہِ النَّارُ الَّتِیۡ کُنۡتُمۡ بِہَا تُکَذِّبُوۡنَ ﴿۱۵﴾
verses.en: ‘This is the Fire which you treated as a lie.

verses.ar: اَفَسِحۡرٌ ہٰذَاۤ اَمۡ اَنۡتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۱۶﴾
verses.en: ‘Is this then magic, or do you not see?

verses.ar: اِصۡلَوۡہَا فَاصۡبِرُوۡۤا اَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُوۡا ۚ سَوَآءٌ عَلَیۡکُمۡ ؕ اِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا کُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ﴿۱۷﴾
verses.en: ‘Burn ye therein; and whether you show patience or you show it not, it will be the same for you. You are requited only for what you used to do.’

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ فِیۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَعِیۡمٍ ﴿ۙ۱۸﴾
verses.en: Verily, the righteous are in Gardens and in bliss,

verses.ar: فٰکِہِیۡنَ بِمَاۤ اٰتٰہُمۡ رَبُّہُمۡ ۚ وَوَقٰہُمۡ رَبُّہُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡجَحِیۡمِ ﴿۱۹﴾
verses.en: Enjoying what their Lord has bestowed on them; and their Lord has saved them from the torment of the Fire.

verses.ar: کُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا ہَنِیۡٓـًٔۢا بِمَا کُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۲۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]‘Eat and drink in happiness because of what you used to do,

verses.ar: مُتَّکِـِٕیۡنَ عَلٰی سُرُرٍ مَّصۡفُوۡفَۃٍ ۚ وَزَوَّجۡنٰہُمۡ بِحُوۡرٍ عِیۡنٍ ﴿۲۱﴾
verses.en: ‘Reclining on couches arranged in rows.’ And We shall consort them with fair maidens having wide, beautiful eyes.

verses.ar: وَالَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَاتَّبَعَتۡہُمۡ ذُرِّیَّتُہُمۡ بِاِیۡمَانٍ اَلۡحَقۡنَا بِہِمۡ ذُرِّیَّتَہُمۡ وَمَاۤ اَلَتۡنٰہُمۡ مِّنۡ عَمَلِہِمۡ مِّنۡ شَیۡءٍ ؕ کُلُّ امۡرِیًٴۢ بِمَا کَسَبَ رَہِیۡنٌ ﴿۲۲﴾
verses.en: And those who believe and whose children follow them in faith — with them shall We join their children. And We will not diminish anything from the reward of their works. Every man stands pledged for what he has earned.

verses.ar: وَاَمۡدَدۡنٰہُمۡ بِفَاکِہَۃٍ وَّلَحۡمٍ مِّمَّا یَشۡتَہُوۡنَ ﴿۲۳﴾
verses.en: And We shall bestow upon them an abundance of fruit and meat such as they will wish for.
w: and We shall bestow upon them

verses.ar: یَتَنَازَعُوۡنَ فِیۡہَا کَاۡسًا لَّا لَغۡوٌ فِیۡہَا وَلَا تَاۡثِیۡمٌ ﴿۲۴﴾
verses.en: There they will pass from one to another a cup wherein is neither levity nor sin.
w: they will pass from one to another

verses.ar: وَیَطُوۡفُ عَلَیۡہِمۡ غِلۡمَانٌ لَّہُمۡ کَاَنَّہُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٌ مَّکۡنُوۡنٌ ﴿۲۵﴾
verses.en: And there will wait upon them youths of their own, as though they were pearls well-preserved.

verses.ar: وَاَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُہُمۡ عَلٰی بَعۡضٍ یَّتَسَآءَلُوۡنَ ﴿۲۶﴾
verses.en: And they will turn to one another, asking mutual questions.

verses.ar: قَالُوۡۤا اِنَّا کُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِیۡۤ اَہۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِیۡنَ ﴿۲۷﴾
verses.en: They will say, ‘Before this, when we were among our family, we were very much afraid of God’s displeasure;

verses.ar: فَمَنَّ اللّٰہُ عَلَیۡنَا وَوَقٰٮنَا عَذَابَ السَّمُوۡمِ ﴿۲۸﴾
verses.en: ‘But Allah has been gracious unto us and has saved us from the torment of the burning blast.

verses.ar: اِنَّا کُنَّا مِنۡ قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوۡہُ ؕ اِنَّہٗ ہُوَ الۡبَرُّ الرَّحِیۡمُ ﴿٪۲۹﴾
verses.en: ‘We used to pray to Him before. Surely, He is the Beneficent, the Merciful.’

verses.ar: فَذَکِّرۡ فَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّکَ بِکَاہِنٍ وَّلَا مَجۡنُوۡنٍ ﴿ؕ۳۰﴾
verses.en: Admonish then. By the grace of thy Lord, thou art neither a soothsayer, nor a madman.

verses.ar: اَمۡ یَقُوۡلُوۡنَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِہٖ رَیۡبَ الۡمَنُوۡنِ ﴿۳۱﴾
verses.en: Do they say, ‘He is a poet; we are waiting for some calamity which time will bring upon him?’

verses.ar: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُوۡا فَاِنِّیۡ مَعَکُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمُتَرَبِّصِیۡنَ ﴿ؕ۳۲﴾
verses.en: Say, ‘Await ye then! I too am with you among those who are waiting.’

verses.ar: اَمۡ تَاۡمُرُہُمۡ اَحۡلَامُہُمۡ بِہٰذَاۤ اَمۡ ہُمۡ قَوۡمٌ طَاغُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۳۳﴾
verses.en: Do their intellect and reason enjoin this upon them or are they a rebellious people?

verses.ar: اَمۡ یَقُوۡلُوۡنَ تَقَوَّلَہٗ ۚ بَلۡ لَّا یُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۳۴﴾
verses.en: Do they say, ‘He has fabricated it?’ Nay, but they would not believe.

verses.ar: فَلۡیَاۡتُوۡا بِحَدِیۡثٍ مِّثۡلِہٖۤ اِنۡ کَانُوۡا صٰدِقِیۡنَ ﴿ؕ۳۵﴾
verses.en: [✲]Let them, then, bring forth an announcement like this, if they speak the truth!

verses.ar: اَمۡ خُلِقُوۡا مِنۡ غَیۡرِ شَیۡءٍ اَمۡ ہُمُ الۡخٰلِقُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۳۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]Have they been created for nothing, or are they themselves the creators?

verses.ar: اَمۡ خَلَقُوا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ ۚ بَلۡ لَّا یُوۡقِنُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۳۷﴾
verses.en: Did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no faith.

verses.ar: اَمۡ عِنۡدَہُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّکَ اَمۡ ہُمُ الۡمُصَۜیۡطِرُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۳۸﴾
verses.en: Do they own the treasures of thy Lord, or are they the guardians thereof ?

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَہُمۡ سُلَّمٌ یَّسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ فِیۡہِ ۚ فَلۡیَاۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُہُمۡ بِسُلۡطٰنٍ مُّبِیۡنٍ ﴿ؕ۳۹﴾
verses.en: Have they a ladder unto heaven by means of which they can overhear? Then let their listener bring a manifest authority.

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَہُ الۡبَنٰتُ وَلَکُمُ الۡبَنُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۴۰﴾
verses.en: Has He daughters and you have sons?

verses.ar: اَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُہُمۡ اَجۡرًا فَہُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّغۡرَمٍ مُّثۡقَلُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۴۱﴾
verses.en: Dost thou ask a reward from them, so that they are weighed down with a load of debt?

verses.ar: اَمۡ عِنۡدَہُمُ الۡغَیۡبُ فَہُمۡ یَکۡتُبُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۴۲﴾
verses.en: Do they possess knowledge of the unseen, so that they write it down?

verses.ar: اَمۡ یُرِیۡدُوۡنَ کَیۡدًا ؕ فَالَّذِیۡنَ کَفَرُوۡا ہُمُ الۡمَکِیۡدُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۴۳﴾
verses.en: Do they intend a plot? But it is those who disbelieve that will be caught in the plot.
w: will be caught in the plot

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَہُمۡ اِلٰہٌ غَیۡرُ اللّٰہِ ؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰہِ عَمَّا یُشۡرِکُوۡنَ ﴿۴۴﴾
verses.en: Have they a God other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above all that which they associate with Him!

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ یَّرَوۡا کِسۡفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا یَّقُوۡلُوۡا سَحَابٌ مَّرۡکُوۡمٌ ﴿۴۵﴾
verses.en: [✲]And if they should see a piece of the cloud falling down, they would say, ‘Clouds piled up.’

verses.ar: فَذَرۡہُمۡ حَتّٰی یُلٰقُوۡا یَوۡمَہُمُ الَّذِیۡ فِیۡہِ یُصۡعَقُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۴۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]So leave them until they meet that day of theirs, on which they will be overtaken by a thunderbolt,
w: they will be overtaken by a thunderbolt

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ لَا یُغۡنِیۡ عَنۡہُمۡ کَیۡدُہُمۡ شَیۡئًا وَّلَا ہُمۡ یُنۡصَرُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۴۷﴾
verses.en: The day when their plotting will not avail them aught, nor shall they be helped.

verses.ar: وَاِنَّ لِلَّذِیۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا عَذَابًا دُوۡنَ ذٰلِکَ وَلٰکِنَّ اَکۡثَرَہُمۡ لَا یَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ﴿۴۸﴾
verses.en: And verily, for those who do wrong there is a punishment besides that. But most of them know not.

verses.ar: وَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُکۡمِ رَبِّکَ فَاِنَّکَ بِاَعۡیُنِنَا وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّکَ حِیۡنَ تَقُوۡمُ ﴿ۙ۴۹﴾
verses.en: So wait patiently for the judgment of thy Lord; for assuredly thou art before Our eyes; and glorify thy Lord with His praise when thou risest up from sleep;

verses.ar: وَمِنَ الَّیۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡہُ وَاِدۡبَارَ النُّجُوۡمِ ﴿٪۵۰﴾
verses.en: And for part of the night also do thou glorify Him and at the setting of the stars.
